why: rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop refuses an agent loop whose query samples intersect the bound snapshot's own source_sample_ids. Cell ROLL-1 flies the 800-row TRAIN construction roster SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01 as its QUERY population, and that roster was drawn from the very construction pool the released parent train-exemplars store is built over, so all 800 query rows were also knowledge source rows. This release removes them.
